description: This file contains functions for building and inspecting channel account snapshots within a plugin system, including handling read-only and configurable account states.

methods.name: buildSnapshotFromAccount
methods.description: Builds a channel account snapshot from a given account, using plugin-specific methods if available.

methods.name: inspectChannelAccount
methods.description: Inspects and retrieves a channel account, either via plugin config or read-only inspection.

methods.name: buildReadOnlySourceChannelAccountSnapshot
methods.description: Builds a read-only channel account snapshot, inspecting the account first.

methods.name: buildChannelAccountSnapshot
methods.description: Builds a channel account snapshot, inspecting the account or resolving it via plugin config.
